summary: Correct docs/release_closure_candidate.md's R5 section, which a fresh independent review found mislabeled the pre-existing, already-committed chmod-detection test (test_committed_executable_bit_change_makes_mode_data_stale, added in the guardian-correction remediation round's D4 fix) as one of R5's 'new tests'.
